reason: A DSH WebUI workspace file browser and editor focused on reviewing agent changes with diff-based accept, reject, and undo workflows.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH WebUI 中浏览、编辑和审阅工作区文件，并通过差异视图接受、拒绝或撤销智能体产生的修改。
summaries.en: Browse, edit, and review workspace files in DSH WebUI with diff-based acceptance, rejection, and undo of agent changes.

capabilities: Browse workspace files and session history
Edit and save workspace files in the browser
Detect and display Git and agent-created file changes
Accept, reject, and undo file changes by writing workspace contents
Persist review state on the host and edit history in browser localStorage
